data.name: Alda
data.long_meaning: The Old Norse name Alda means old or ancestral. In Norse mythology, Alda was the name of the goddess of old age and wisdom. This name is rich in history and carries a sense of nobility and wisdom.

It may also serve as a reminder to seek out wisdom and knowledge, particularly as we age. This name can be an inspiration for those seeking to age gracefully and live a life full of wisdom and experience.
